course.title: Codecademy Python: Learn Python 3 + Learn Intermediate Python 3
course.format: self-paced interactive browser course; Learn Python 3 (13 modules, ~24 h, 14 lessons, 14 projects, 13 quizzes, 21 articles, 1 video) followed by Learn Intermediate Python 3 (9 modules, ~20 h, 11 lessons, 7 projects, 11 quizzes, 5 articles, 2 videos)
course.audience: Learn Python 3: beginners with no prerequisites; Learn Intermediate Python 3: learners who finished Learn Python 3
course.notes: Retrieved 2026-10-12 from the course pages' embedded syllabus data (module titles, content-item types and titles) and from each lesson page's exercise list. Learn Python 3 is described as teaching Python 3.13; both courses are marked Pro-only (paid plan) with certificates. Module titles are prefixed with the course name. topics list each content item with its type (Lesson/Quiz/Article/Video/Informational); parenthesised text summarises the lesson's exercise titles. Quizzes are named after their lesson and are not separately scored here. Projects named in older versions of the course or the CS path (e.g. 'Hurricane Analysis', 'Scrabble') are NOT in the current Learn Python 3 syllabus and were omitted; current named projects are listed per module. The Intermediate 'Unit Testing' module also contains the Exceptions lesson (exceptions/raising/custom exceptions are first taught there, not in Learn Python 3, except for the 'Errors in Python' debugging lesson). Specialized Collections covers sets plus the collections module; Resource Management covers context managers incl. contextlib. 'Namespaces' is mapped to the 'scope' concept. Concept mappings for articles, videos and projects are inferred from titles (not opened); depth ratings are judgement calls. Codecademy also offers split-out mini-courses (e.g. 'Learn Intermediate Python 3: Functions, Namespaces, and Scope') that repackage this content; they were not captured separately. New concept IDs: itertools_module, collections_module.
